title: KeyManagerStatusKind
description: Where a key-manager connection stands: awaiting-sign-in (no credential here: a copy, an import, or signed out), signing-in (a login is under way), signed-in, credential-rejected (sign in again), expired (a token login past its maximum life), unreachable, sealed (OpenBao only) or certificate-rejected (the key manager's certificate does not verify against the pinned CA, or with none pinned the system's).
